In today’s show, we will discuss:
1. How Diabetes Affects Your Vision: How does diabetes affect your eyes? Can it lead to vision loss? What are the early warning signs of diabetic retinopathy? How often should people with diabetes get their eyes examined? We also discuss the treatment options and ways to prevent diabetic retinopathy. Guest: Dr. Ashvin Agarwal, Chief Clinical Officer, Dr. Agarwals Eye Hospital.
